cipansi.name: Cipansi
cipansi.company: Yancheng Jie Chanel Fashion Co., Ltd (Cipansi brand)
cipansi.prices: FOB USD per piece from the 2026 catalogue PDF (pages 36-82), converted to NZD; the markup and exchange rate are in private.json. Delivery is charged on top by weight (NZ rate card: NZ$30.11 first kg + NZ$22.19 per extra kg).
cipansi.excluded: Football jerseys pp.1-35 (replica club and national kits); S.W.A.T. POLICE tees; lines with US Navy SEAL trident or US-seal eagle insignia; denim jacket (Emerson Gear branding); printed-photo tees; colourways whose only photo shows a firearm.
